semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-precision vacuum motors and actuators specifically designed for ultra-high vacuum environments critical to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Magnetic Innovations B.V. develops advanced electric motors and actuators tailored for vacuum applications in the semiconductor industry. Their products, including stainless-steel encapsulated motors and hermetically sealed actuators, are engineered to minimize contamination and ensure reliability in demanding environments.
capabilities: High-precision vacuum motors for ultra-high vacuum applications
Hermetically sealed actuators for semiconductor environments
Custom electromechanical solutions for contamination-sensitive applications

regional_presence.Netherlands: The company operates from its R&D and manufacturing hub in the Dutch Brainport Region.
